sentences.en: Why have so many individuals throughout history wished to be conquerors?
sentences.zh: 为什么历史上有那么多人都希望自己能成为征服者？

sentences.en: Why would I want to be a conqueror?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要成为征服者呢？

sentences.en: Greece, conquered, took captive her savage conqueror.
sentences.zh: 被希腊征服后，她俘虏了那位野蛮的征服者。
